_comment: The Sims 4's OWN shader-parameter vocabulary: the names its materials state, which the decoder reverses from their hashes. Only names whose meaning the game itself makes unambiguous are stated here. A parameter left out is reported as unmapped rather than guessed at -- this game's Phong-era vocabulary has several names (Shininess, Transparency, Specular as a colour) whose meaning is NOT a physical role, and wiring them into one would look right and read wrong.
